summary:
Compiling TikZ figure exists (latest v3, best_version v2 per the tool). It draws rectangle ABCD with labels A, B, C, D, E, the diagonal as a polyline A-E-C, segment BE, and a right-angle mark at E. Labels were bound by the CV tools and confirmed visually. circle_01 was judged spurious because no arc is visible in the original. Repairs removed any curve/arc commands from the source and raised the stroke width to 1.5pt.

The critic's score stayed at 0.72 across v1, v2 and v3 and returned a cached verdict each time, so v2 and v3 have not been independently re-scored. Its remaining high-severity complaint is that the A–E stroke looks curved; the source now uses straight segments, so this is likely stale.
